metrics.normalized_w1: scipy.stats.wasserstein_distance(a,b) / scale; scale=(IQR_a+IQR_b)/2, fallback pooled std, floor 1e-12

claim_boundary.allowed: Describe public posterior shifts/widths/W1/interval overlap for the frozen paired comparisons and provenance dimension.
claim_boundary.forbidden: Do not infer H0 truth, solve the Hubble tension, or causally assign a posterior difference beyond the explicitly paired public-output dimension.
claim_boundary.confounded_C07: C07 combines population-model and event-frame changes and must retain that label.

stopping_rules: If any whitelisted file checksum fails, HOLD before metric computation.
If a Bilby result cannot expose finite H0 samples under the frozen loader, mark PUBLIC_OUTPUT_LIMITED; do not reverse-engineer or substitute a different parameter.
If fewer than 100 finite H0 samples remain, mark INSUFFICIENT_PUBLIC_POSTERIOR and exclude from pair metrics.
Do not add modified-gravity Xi0/cM/Om0 or spin-variant files after seeing primary results; those remain inventory-only unless a new preregistered extension is created.
Do not add routes to rescue or amplify a weak dependence finding.
